performance_levels.label: Exceeds Expectations
performance_levels.description: Consistently demonstrates mastery; applies skills independently; shows accuracy, depth, and confidence.

performance_levels.label: Meets Expectations
performance_levels.description: Demonstrates grade-level proficiency; completes tasks with minimal support; shows solid understanding.

performance_levels.label: Approaching Expectations
performance_levels.description: Partial understanding; needs support or reminders; inconsistent performance.

performance_levels.label: Needs Support
performance_levels.description: Limited understanding; requires significant guidance; skills not yet developed.
